task.question: How many new asteroids did astronomers announce discovering using preliminary data from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory on 2 April 2026?
task.evidence: Astronomers using preliminary data from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory announce the discovery of over 11,000 new asteroids, including hundreds of trans-Neptunian objects and 33 previously unknown near-Earth objects.

answer:
On 2 April 2026, astronomers using preliminary data from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory announced the discovery of over 11,000 new asteroids, including hundreds of trans-Neptunian objects and 33 previously unknown near-Earth objects. 

FINAL: over 11,000 new asteroids
